Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stake Lowered by Ameriprise Financial Inc. Posted by Dante Gardener | Mar 2nd, 2018 
Ameriprise Financial Inc. trimmed its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6.2% during the third quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The firm owned 26,797,162 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,758,264 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 2.0% of Ameriprise Financial Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Ameriprise Financial Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,130,096,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
Several other hedge funds have also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Sowell Financial Services LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 1.5% during the third quarter. Sowell Financial Services LLC now owns 74,815 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,486,000 after acquiring an additional 1,101 shares during the last quarter. Hilton Capital Management LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 36.4% during the third quarter. Hilton Capital Management LLC now owns 18,926 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,917,000 after acquiring an additional 5,050 shares during the last quarter. Commonwealth Equity Services Inc raised its position in shares of Apple by 1.6% during the third quarter. Commonwealth Equity Services Inc now owns 2,627,446 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $404,942,000 after acquiring an additional 40,885 shares during the last quarter. RKL Wealth Management LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 5.2% during the third quarter. RKL Wealth Management LLC now owns 22,855 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,517,000 after acquiring an additional 1,131 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Caldwell & Orkin Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 258.2% during the third quarter. Caldwell & Orkin Inc. now owns 17,195 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,650,000 after acquiring an additional 12,395 shares during the last quarter. 59.70% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) opened at $175.00 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $137.05 and a 1 year high of $180.62. The firm has a market capitalization of $887,950.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.12, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.33. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $3.36 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 EPS for the current year. 
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th were given a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.44%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 24.66%. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
